Dear {{ doc.applicant_name }},
                                    Subject: Letter of Intent of Employment

We are pleased to offer you the {{ ns.job_nature }} employment of {{ ns.job_position }} at Sravi Enterprises - Kolapakkam, Chennai with a start date of {{ ns.joining_date }}. Your CTC will be {{ ns.ctc }} per annum. The breakup of the same is attached in Annexure 2.


You will be posted anywhere in the jurisdiction of the "Company". As on the date of appointment, you will be posted to {{ ns.location}}. Let us know priorly, for any support of your onboarding. Please ensure to submit us the following documents while joining


  1. All the eductional certificates (One set of copies along with Originals)
  2. Full set copies of previous Company Experience & Releiving Letter(If applicable)
  3. Set of last 3 months payslips and relevant bank statement (If applicable)
  4. Photocopy of PAN & Aadhar
  5. Photocopy of Bank Passbook (for Salary Credit)
  6. 2 Passport sized photos
  7. Medical Fitness Certificate
  8. A Signed Copy of Offer Letter

                                             Background Verification

This Offer/Appointment shall, at all times, be subject to successful clearance of Background Verfification (BGV) Process. BGV will be conducted areas including your education, prior employement (s), criminal records, and such other areas may be required by "Company" or third party appointed by "Company"

If any of the information provided by the applicant is found to be false or inaccurate or incorrect, or if any feedback received while conducting BGV is negative, "Company" holds the right to withdraw the Offer/Appointment and terminate your employement with immediatte effect

                                             Annexure 1
                                             Job Description
{{ns.responsibilities }}
Note:
Job activities might change from time to time and will be communicated from time to time

{{doc.terms}}
By agreeing to this offer letter, you are agreeing to following Terms and Conditions
  1. You will be governed by the rules applicable to the position you are employed
  2. The Probationary period as per the Company Policy for the applicable position is 6 months from the date of joining.
  3. The notice period will be 1 Month while in Probation. During the Probation period, Probationer fails to execute the required advance notice intimation, will attract payment equal to one month's gross salary in lieu of failure. After satisfactory completion of probation period, the notice period is {{ ns.notice_period }}
  4. You will follow the working hours and participation as per stipulated requirements
  5. Need to follow the rules and procedures of the Company with respect to employement, performance, confidentiality & exclusiveness of participation
  6. Performance is critical requirement for all positions. This needs to be matched as per goals and targets discussed with Seniors and HR need to be kept in Communication at all times as required
  7. All statutory obligations are borne by the Employee himself
For SRAVI ENTERPRISES

ACCEPTED & SIGNED with DATE

Vinod Kumar. K
Prop.
